presets.label: Default
presets.description: The grid's own look, with every token at its default: a template to copy.

presets.label: Spreadsheet
presets.description: Dense rows, square corners, a grey header and firm lines between every cell.

presets.label: Comfortable
presets.description: Roomy rows, soft violet tints, rounded corners and no lines between columns.

presets.label: High contrast
presets.description: Black and white with strong lines, larger small text and thick focus rings, at WCAG AAA contrast.

presets.label: Midnight
presets.description: Deep indigo and a vivid violet accent, with an uppercase header and striped rows.
